dmu.text: Sheoldred arrives on Dominaria through the Planar Bridge, beginning the Second Phyrexian Invasion in 4562 AR, and recuperates in the Caves of Koilos, where Rona and the Society of Mishra rebuild her.
Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel to her staging ground, where acolytes compleat humans, and when he touches her she whispers that sleeper agents are hidden in every land of Dominaria.
As Karn plants an incendiary device inside her, Rona paralyzes him and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
Sheoldred mass-produces sleeper agents, resurrects Ertai and compleats Ajani Goldmane, then leads the attack at the Battle of the Mana Rig on a dragon engine and captures Karn.
